info.title: MailBluster Universal API
info.description: Manage MailBluster email marketing resources including leads, custom fields, products, orders, and ecommerce activity through the MailBluster API.

post.description: Creates a new lead in MailBluster.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

subscribed.description: Whether the lead is subscribed to receive email.

doubleOptIn.description: If true, MailBluster sends an opt-in confirmation email; keep false for direct create flows unless intentionally needed.

post.description: Creates a new order in MailBluster.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

customer.description: Customer object for the order, including email and optional name/subscription fields.

currency.description: Order currency code, such as USD.

items[].description: Array of products included in the order.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID to associate with the order.
